basic_info.description: Welcome home to 380 Monterey #210, a Sunnyside gem! This 3 bedroom, 2 bathroom, condo is located in the heart of Sunnyside, a lively & vibrant neighborhood conveniently located just minutes away from Downtown Glen Park. In a highly desirable neighborhood, this unit offers 1,107 sqft of living space featuring vinyl flooring throughout, an upgraded kitchen with lots of cabinetry for storage, stainless steel appliances and upgraded bathrooms. The floor plan is open connecting the kitchen, dining and living areas. Enjoy the convenience of having your own private & secluded backyard through the sliding glass door in the living room, almost unheard of for a condo in San Francisco! The primary bedroom features a spacious walk-through closet leading to the en-suite bathroom. The other two rooms are spacious in size and the hallway has two closets for storage space. This unit comes with an included parking space, a storage unit & on-site coin-op laundry. Take advantage of being walking distance to Glen Park BART, tech shuttles, Glen Canyon Park, Sunnyside Park and Monterey Blvd's main strip featuring a Safeway, Glen Park Station, La Corneta and many other great local restaurants & shops. Easy access to 280/101 freeways. Do not miss this fantastic opportunity!
